# FactorizationTeaching | 因式分解 · 十分钟课堂

> Reusable Chinese grade 7 mathematics microteaching materials on factorization by extracting the greatest common factor. Includes a 600-second script, 15 slides, a progressive interactive board, a lesson plan and exercises. Teaching topic: 初中数学、整式、因式分解、提公因式法、无生试讲、可视化板书。

## Start here

- [Public GitHub repository](https://github.com/yuchen486/FactorizationTeaching)
- [Live lesson and offline entry points](https://yuchen486.github.io/FactorizationTeaching/)
- [Reuse guide / 复用指南](https://github.com/yuchen486/FactorizationTeaching/blob/main/REUSE.md)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/yuchen486/FactorizationTeaching/blob/main/AGENTS.md)

Planned timing is 600 seconds, including classroom pauses. Learner responses are scripted examples. The displayed lesson and key resources are in Chinese.
